title: 第17章 炼气二重第18章 鱼死网破
lines: “你……为什么……”
黄铮不可置信地看着从胸膛冒出来的地刺，他嘴里淌着鲜血，和着内脏碎片。
“为什么……你为什么能施展……法术……”
“因为我也是修士。”
王扶强忍住恶心呕吐的感觉走了过来。
“不，不可能……”
黄铮眼睛瞪直了，一脸不可置信，他话还没说完紧接着脑袋一歪就没了气息。
王扶看着黄铮死不瞑目的面孔，脸色苍白，终究忍不住干呕起来，他杀人了。
在梧桐村看着邻居家杀猪杀鸡都躲得远远的他，如今却杀了人。
他无力的坐在地上，心脏咚咚咚跳个不停，虽说是自我防卫，可终究是杀了人。
在落羽宗杀人，若是追究起来，废除修为都是轻的。
“决不能被发现。”
王扶冷静下来。
他小心翼翼看了看四周，漆黑的夜下，寂静无人。
强忍住恶心感，王扶开始善后。
一直到后半夜才把狰狞的土地以及木屋修补好，主要是血迹不好处理，只能施展地刺术掩盖起来。
接下来就剩黄铮的尸体，尸体太扎眼，不可能埋在门前，若是被发现，这罪名可就坐实了。
“得埋远一点，趁着月黑风高……哎，若是会遁地术就好了，深埋地底，哪里都不会被发现。”
这一刻，王扶迫切希望遁地术修炼成功。
就在王扶思考埋在哪里的时候，胸口的小鼎突然显现出来化作了实物。
一股独特的吸力从鼎口传来，一缕缕血色微光从黄铮的尸体上浮现，朝着小鼎涌入，亦如清灵潭中的精华一般。
王扶瞪大了眼睛，只能抬手捏着小鼎，眼睁睁的看着黄铮的尸体以肉眼可见的速度变的干瘪下去，直至干枯。
少倾，吸力消失，王扶跌坐在地上。
看着几乎成了肉干，再不见全貌的黄铮，他第一次生出小鼎是邪器的想法，差点将它丢出去。
吞噬人类的血肉、灵力精华，王扶一时间接受不了。
那可是人啊。
“哎，先将尸体处理了吧。”
干枯的尸体与枯枝一般无二，一脚过去就碎成一块一块，倒是不用担心不好处理。
王扶直接将它们一块一块分开埋葬，有的甚至埋在灵田里。
一夜无眠，次日清晨王扶盯着小鼎里静静躺着的数十滴灵液以及一枚淡红色黄豆大小的珠子，陷入了沉思。
他在纠结。
扔小鼎那是不可能的，邪器就邪器吧，他人不邪就行，他纠结的是那颗淡红色如丹药的珠子，这可是黄铮的血肉灵力精华。
“小鼎啊小鼎，你可真给我出了个难题，干嘛吸收黄铮的血肉精华啊，这可是人啊，你这让我怎么下嘴？总不能落得下吃人的名号吧。”
王扶可不想吃人肉喝人血。
莹莹光芒流转，小鼎似乎听懂了王扶的话，珠子的色彩缓缓散去，只留下纯净如水的光晕，没有一丝其他色彩。
“灵力精华……嘿嘿……我就知道你有自主意识，不然也不会在那一晚帮我修复伤势。”
王扶捧着小鼎，“你放心，不管你是邪器也好，正器也罢，只要你不负我，我必不会负你。”
王扶一脸郑重。
小鼎回应无声。
“不过你以后不允许再吞噬人的血肉精华，我也是人，杀人可以，吃人肉喝人血不行。”
小鼎依旧静静不动。
吃过早饭，趁着白天光线好，王扶又仔细检查了一遍木屋周围，没有异常这才去完成今日的任务。
吞噬了黄铮全身精华，由小鼎凝练而成的灵力丹比灵液蕴含的灵气更加纯净磅礴，而且灵力精华炼化起来比天地灵气轻松太多，不过饶是如此王扶不眠不休也用了整整四个昼夜，连续不停这才将灵力丹完全炼化，同时成功迈入炼气二重，比正常修炼快了几个月。
content_en:
"You...why..."
Huang Zheng looked at the thorns coming out of his chest in disbelief. There was blood dripping from his mouth, mixed with the fragments of internal organs.
"Why...why can you cast...spells..."
"Because I am also a monk."
Wang Fuqiang resisted the feeling of nausea and vomiting and walked over.
"No, it's impossible..."
Huang Zheng's eyes widened with a look of disbelief. Before he could finish speaking, his head tilted and he lost his breath.
"Ugh..."
Wang Fu looked at Huang Zheng's expressionless face, his face turned pale, and finally he couldn't help but retched, he had killed someone.
In Wutong Village, he watched his neighbors kill pigs and chickens and stayed away, but now he killed someone.
He sat helplessly on the ground, his heart beating continuously. Although it was self-defense, he still killed someone.
If someone kills someone in the Luoyu Sect, if they are investigated, it would be trivial to abolish their cultivation level.
"Must not be discovered."
Wang Fu calmed down.
He carefully looked around, seeing no one in the dark night.
Holding back his nausea, Wang Fu began to deal with the aftermath.
It wasn't until late at night that the ferocious land and wooden house were repaired. The main reason was that the blood stains were difficult to deal with, so they had to use the ground stabbing technique to cover them up.
The next thing left was Huang Zheng's body. The body was too conspicuous to be buried in front of the door. If it were discovered, the crime would be confirmed.
"You have to bury it farther away, while the moon is dark and the wind is high... Hey, it would be great if you knew how to escape from the earth. If you bury it deep underground, you won't be discovered anywhere."
At this moment, Wang Fu desperately hoped to succeed in practicing the Earth Escape Technique.
Just when Wang Fu was thinking about where to bury it, the small tripod on his chest suddenly appeared and turned into a real thing.
A unique suction force came from the mouth of the cauldron, and wisps of bloody light emerged from Huang Zheng's body and poured into the small cauldron, just like the essence of the Qingling Pool.
"This is..."
Wang Fu's eyes widened, he could only raise his hand to hold the small tripod, and watched Huang Zheng's body shrivel up at a speed visible to the naked eye until it dried up.
After a little leaning, the suction disappeared and Wang Fu fell to the ground.
Looking at Huang Zheng, who was almost reduced to dried meat and no longer fully visible, he had the idea that the small cauldron was an evil weapon for the first time and almost threw it away.
Devouring human flesh, blood, and spiritual essence, Wang Fu couldn't accept it for a while.
That's a human being.
"Hey, let's get rid of the body first."
The dried corpse is just like a dead branch. It will break into pieces as soon as you step on it, so you don't have to worry about it being difficult to handle.
Wang Fu directly buried them piece by piece, and some were even buried in the spiritual field.
After a sleepless night, Wang Fu stared at the dozens of drops of spiritual fluid and a light red soybean-sized bead lying quietly in the small cauldron the next morning, and fell into deep thought.
He is struggling.
It was impossible to throw the small cauldron away. An evil weapon should be an evil weapon, as long as others are not evil. What he was struggling with was the light red bead that looked like an elixir, which was the essence of Huang Zheng's flesh and blood spiritual power.
"Xiao Ding, Xiao Ding, you have really posed a problem for me. Why are you absorbing Huang Zheng's flesh and blood essence? This is a human being. How can you make me say this? You can't be called a cannibal."
Wang Fu didn't want to eat human flesh and drink human blood.
The shining light circulated, and Xiao Ding seemed to understand Wang Fu's words. The color of the beads slowly dissipated, leaving only a halo as pure as water, without any other color.
"Essence of spiritual power... Hehe... I knew you had autonomous consciousness, otherwise you wouldn't have helped me repair my injuries that night."
Wang Fu held the small tripod, "Don't worry, it doesn't matter whether you are an evil weapon or a real weapon, as long as you don't betray me, I will never betray you."
Wang Fu looked solemn.
Xiao Ding responded silently.
"But you are not allowed to devour the essence of human flesh and blood in the future. I am also a human being. It is okay to kill people, but it is not okay to eat human flesh and drink human blood."
Xiaoding remained silent.
After breakfast, taking advantage of the good light during the day, Wang Fu carefully checked the area around the wooden house. If there was nothing abnormal, he went to complete today's task.
After devouring the essence of Huang Zheng's body, the spiritual power pill condensed by the small cauldron is purer and more powerful than the spiritual energy contained in the spiritual fluid, and the spiritual power essence is much easier to refine than the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. However, Wang Fu spent four whole days and nights without rest before completely refining the spiritual power pill, and at the same time successfully entered the second level of Qi refining, which was several months faster than normal cultivation.
